name: Not Enough Kittens
review:
A cat-obsessed professor on 35 ways, with double symbols and free spins that can retrigger.

Double symbols count as two of a kind, which helps ways wins add up quickly, and retriggers can stretch the bonus out nicely. The mad-professor theme is pure Thunderkick whimsy, with gentle maths behind it. Low volatility, a surprisingly high 3,650x cap and a 96.1% RTP. Great for long sessions.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
